mapper.select: SELECT a.id, cp.id 'project.id', cp.name 'project.name', cp.short_name 'project.short_name', cp.serial_number 'project.serial_number', pm.`id` 'monomer.id', pm.`name` 'monomer.name', pd.`id` 'area.id', pd.`name` 'area.name', process.id AS 'process.id', process.name AS 'process.name', ta.serial_number serialNumber, production_line.id 'productionLine.id', production_line.name 'productionLine.name', a.number, a.avg_thickness, a.bool_adopt_enum, a.bool_paint_thickness_adopt_enum, a.min_thickness, a.max_thickness, su2.name as reporterName, su.name as inspectionName, tul.user_name as 'teamUserName', c.report_time reportTime, a.report_time reportTime2 FROM `mes_building_produce_inspection_team_report` a LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta on ta.id = a.product_id AND ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON ta.project_id = cp.id AND cp.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON ta.monomer_id = pm.id AND pm.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN plan_area pd ON ta.area_id = pd.id AND pd.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN mes_building_production_line production_line ON a.production_line_id = production_line.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_team_user_link tul ON a.team_id = tul.team_id AND tul.bool_leader_enum = 1 AND tul.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_process process ON process.id = a.process_id AND process.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_produce_team_report c ON c.product_id = a.product_id and c.number = a.number and c.task_type_enum = a.task_type_enum and a.process_id = c.process_id AND c.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN sys_user su on su.id = a.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user su2 on su2.id = c.user_id where a.bool_delete_enum = 0 and a.bool_paint_thickness_adopt_enum is not NULL and avg_thickness is not null and a.task_type_enum = 2 and a.id = #{id}
